meta.name: og-test-design-a
meta.notes: The DS-01 REV00 installation moved into the SOLIT2 test tunnel preset for the fire test. Nozzle, zones, detection and hydraulics are copied from og-ds01-rev00-cd-meas.json; only the tunnel, fire, mounting height (5.0 m under the 5.2 m crown), discharge duration and SOLIT2's 1.5-3.0 m/s test velocities differ. The booked laboratory's real tunnel replaces the preset when the laboratory supplies it.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria.

ahj.note: Only one acceptance limit is set, because only one is stated by an authority. HPWM-TECHNICAL SPEC_R2 section 6 requires a 150 MW minimum design fire load reduced to <= 50 MW. Every other Annex 7 criterion stays null and is reported 'unset': the tender defers tenability to 'SOLIT2 or NFPA 502 test protocols' without naming numbers, and Annex 7 7.1 leaves those to the authority having jurisdiction. Do not fill them from a vendor's test report -- see INDEPENDENCE.md rule 2.
